title: Giants getting serious with DJ Reader in quest to bulk up defensive line around disgruntled Dexter Lawrence

sources.name: Yahoo Sports NFL
sources.title: Giants getting serious with DJ Reader in quest to bulk up defensive line around disgruntled Dexter Lawrence
sources.description: The 31-year old was in for a visit on Monday, The Post confirmed, and this was not just a look-see meeting. Something could get done with him within the next two weeks.
